```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rjags)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
library(HDInterval)
```

```{r}
library(parallel)
library(doFuture)
library(foreach)
library(progressr)
library(future)

if(detectCores() >= 30) {
  numCores = 25
}

registerDoFuture()
plan(multisession, workers = numCores)

handlers("progress")

required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "rjags", "HDInterval")
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
### JAGS Scripts
source("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Function/Helper_Script-Function/JAGS_Scripts.R")

### Generating Trial Data
source("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Helper_Functions/Fun-Generating_Trial.R")

### Evaluate Heterogeneity
source("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Function/Fun-Bayesian_RiskModel_Heterogeneity.R")

### Alternative Methods to Evaluate Heterogeneity
source("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Helper_Functions/Fun-Alternative_Methods.R")

### Cleaning Simulation Output
source("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Helper_Functions/Fun-Cleaning_Sim_Output.R")

```

```{r}
### Simulation Size
N_iter  <- 1000 # Number of iterations


### MCMC definitions
Iterations <- 2500
Burn_in <- 2500


### Each Situation we wish to simulate through
Z4.types        <- c("Categorical", "Continuous")
T_Effects       <- c(0.50, 1.00)
H_Effects       <- c(0.00, 0.50, 1.00)
Noise.Vars_list <- c(10)
N_trials        <- c(50, 100, 200)


### Simulation outcomes
Heterogeneity_List <- list()
```

```{r}
### Simulation Study -----------------------------------------------------------------



### Declarations ---------------------------------------------------------------


for(i in 1:length(H_Effects)) {

Z4.type    <- Z4.types[1]         # Z4 Definition
T_Effect   <- T_Effects[2]        # Treatment Effect
H_Effect   <- H_Effects[i]        # Heterogeneity Effect
Noise.Vars <- Noise.Vars_list[1]  # Number of Noise Variables
N_trial    <- N_trials[1]         # Sample Size of Generated Trial

### Creating the base file path for simulation
base_path <- paste0(getwd(), "/Output/",
               Z4.type, "/",
               "TrtEff_", T_Effect, "-HetEff_", H_Effect, "/")
if (!dir.exists(base_path)) {
  dir.create(base_path)
}


### Simulation -----------------------------------------------------------------

Heterogeneity_List <- with_progress({

p <- progressor(along = 1:N_iter)

foreach(i = 1:N_iter, .options.future = list(seed = TRUE,
                                             packages = required_packages)                              ) %dofuture% {
  
  p(sprintf("iteration %d", i))
  
  Trial_Data <- Gen_Trial_Data(N_trial, 
                               Z4.type, 
                               Noise.Vars, 
                               T_Effect = T_Effect, H_Effect = T_Effect, 
                               Outcome_Var = 0.50)
    
  Heterogeneity <- Risk_Heterogeneity(Trial_Data, Burn_in, Iterations, 
                                      SSVS_script = model_string.SSVS,
                                      Risk_script = model_string.Risk, 
                                      Heterogeneity_script = model_string.Heterogeneity)
  
  if(Noise.Vars >= 1) {
    Heterogeneity_Noise <- Risk_Heterogeneity(Trial_Data, Burn_in, Iterations, 
                                              SSVS_script = model_string.SSVS,
                                              Risk_script = model_string.Risk, 
                                              Heterogeneity_script = model_string.Heterogeneity,
                                              Optimized = FALSE) 
    }
  
  Alternative_Results <- Alternative_Methods(Trial_Data, Noise.Vars)
  
  Output <- Clean_Output(Trial_Data, 
                         Heterogeneity, 
                         Heterogeneity_Noise, 
                         Alternative_Results, 
                         N_trial, Noise.Vars)
    
  list(Output = Output,
       Selection_Probability = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability},
       Variable_Selections = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections},
       R_hat_Heterogeneity = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat )) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat},
       R_hat_Risk = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat})
}

})


### Storing results separately -------------------------------------------------
Results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Output"))
Selection_Probability <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Selection_Probability")
Variable_Selections <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Variable_Selections")
R_hat_Heterogeneity <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Heterogeneity")
R_hat_Risk <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Risk")


### Saving Results -------------------------------------------------------------

### Results .csv file
path <- paste0(base_path,
               "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars, ".csv")
write_csv(Results, path)


### Selection Probability .rds file
select_path <- paste0(base_path, "Selection_Probability/")
if (!dir.exists(select_path)) {
  dir.create(select_path)
}
write_rds(Selection_Probability, paste0(select_path,
               "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars,
                "-SelectProb.rds"))


### Variable Selections .rds file
VarSelect_path <- paste0(base_path, "Variable_Selection/")
if (!dir.exists(VarSelect_path)) {
  dir.create(VarSelect_path)
}
write_rds(Variable_Selections, paste0(VarSelect_path,
               "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars,
                "-VarSelection.rds"))


### Diagnostics .rds files
diag_path <- paste0(base_path, "Diagnostics/")
if (!dir.exists(diag_path)) {
  dir.create(diag_path)
}
write_rds(list(R_hat_Risk, R_hat_Heterogeneity), 
          paste0(diag_path,
                 "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars,
                 "-Diag.rds"))


### Printing Simulation Details ------------------------------------------------

Summary_Print <- Results |>
  summarise(
    Power.Risk = sum(rejection.Risk == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Risk_Noise = sum(rejection.Risk_Noise == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Intx = sum(rejection.interaction == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.SDIR = sum(rejection.SDIR == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter
  )


cat(paste(
  "*****************************************************",
  "\nSimulation Completed:\n",
  "\nNumber of Iterations: ", N_iter," \n",
  "    Trial Size: ", N_trial, "\n",
  "    Treatment Effect: ", T_Effect, "; Heterogeneity Effect: ", H_Effect, "\n",
  "   ", Z4.type, " Definition of Z4", "\n",
  "   ", Noise.Vars, " Noise variables considered\n",
  "\nPower Summary:", "\n",
  "   Optimized Model: ", Summary_Print[1], "\n",
  "   Non-optimized Model: ", Summary_Print[2], "\n",
  "   Interaction: ", Summary_Print[3], "\n",
  "   SDIR: ", Summary_Print[4], "\n",
  "\n*****************************************************"
  )
)

}
```

### 1. No Heterogeneity -- Categorical Prognostic Variable -- Noise Variables

```{r}
Noise.type         <- Noise.types[1]
Heterogeneity.type <- Heterogeneity.types[1]
Z4.type       <- Z4.types[1]

Sim_Trials <- foreach(i = 1:N_iter, .packages = c("tidyverse")) %dopar% {
  seed <- 1000000 + i
  Gen_Trial_Data(N_trial, seed, Heterogeneity.type, Z4.type, Noise.type)
}
```


```{r}
### Tracking Runtime 
start_time <- Sys.time()

### Simulation
Heterogeneity_List <- foreach(i = 1:N_iter, .packages = required_packages) %dopar% {
    
  Trial_Data <- Sim_Trials[[i]]
    
  Heterogeneity <- Risk_Heterogeneity(Trial_Data, Burn_in, Iterations, 
                                      SSVS_script = model_string.SSVS,
                                      Risk_script = model_string.Risk, 
                                      Heterogeneity_script = model_string.Heterogeneity)
  
  if(Noise.type == "Noise") {
    Heterogeneity_Noise <- Risk_Heterogeneity(Trial_Data, Burn_in, Iterations, 
                                              SSVS_script = model_string.SSVS,
                                              Risk_script = model_string.Risk, 
                                              Heterogeneity_script = model_string.Heterogeneity,
                                              Optimized = FALSE) 
    }
  
  Alternative_Results <- Alternative_Methods(Trial_Data)
  
  Output <- Clean_Output(Trial_Data, Heterogeneity, Heterogeneity_Noise, Alternative_Methods, N_trial)
    
  list(Output = Output,
       Selection_Probability = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability},
       Variable_Selections = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections},
       R_hat_Heterogeneity = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat )) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat},
       R_hat_Risk = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat})
}

### Storing results seperately
Results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Output"))
Selection_Probability <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Selection_Probability")
Variable_Selections <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Variable_Selections")
R_hat_Heterogeneity <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Heterogeneity")
R_hat_Risk <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Risk")


### End runtime tracking
end_time <- Sys.time()
time_elapsed <- end_time - start_time; time_elapsed

Results |>
  summarise(
    Power.Risk = sum(rejection.Risk == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Risk_Noise = sum(rejection.Risk_Noise == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Intx = sum(rejection.interaction == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.SDIR = sum(rejection.SDIR == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    SSVS.X1 = sum(str_detect(SSVS_results, "X1")),
    SSVS.X2 = sum(str_detect(SSVS_results, "X2"))
  )

path <- paste0("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", Z4.type, "-", Noise.type, ".csv")

write_csv(Results, path)

write_rds(Selection_Probability, paste0("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/2-Selection_Probability/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", Z4.type, "-", Noise.type, "-SelectProb.rds"))

write_rds(R_hat_Heterogeneity, paste0("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/1-Diagnostics/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", Z4.type, "-", Noise.type, "-R_hat_Heterogeneity.rds"))

write_rds(Variable_Selections, paste0("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/3-Variable_Selection/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", Z4.type, "-", Noise.type, "-Variable_Selections.rds"))

write_rds(R_hat_Risk, paste0("~/Thesis/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/1-Diagnostics/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", Z4.type, "-", Noise.type, "-R_hat_Risk.rds"))
```

```{r}
Results |>

  )
```
